summary: Host Alien claimed the MB-006 migration stage. Digital-City claim commit 3bb6a1c3ea80781a4912b604d388b8bf7fa4b139 pushed to City main. MB-001 (Alien) and MB-003 (Alien) are migration-complete; MB-002 and MB-005 are migration-complete under host Mech. MB-004 is the lowest-sequence unclaimed migration but declares a dependency on MB-003, which is unverified and unmerged, so a branch cut from main could not contain it; MB-006 declares no dependency and is claimed instead. Branch mission/MB-006-restart-recovery created from utopia main c7ef3cd1c6be0155332d03afc3607dfdbf49c205.

Reconnaissance started. Target is a NEW building city/02-engineering/04-restart-recovery-station. Single donor dsh-restart @ e20fb6cc. Mission scope: request validation, dedup/lock/cooldown; checkpoint/safe-point gate; atomic checksummed restart ticket; graceful shutdown request, external supervisor heartbeat, exit observation/relaunch; post-relaunch verification; crash-loop breaker/safe mode; append-only audit. Explicitly forbidden: deciding whether to restart, inventing a WAITING_FOR_EXIT deadline, enabling the donor's declared-but-unused force-terminate behaviour, and extending into general power management.

Landed four modules in a NEW building city/02-engineering/04-restart-recovery-station: restart-protocol (donor src/shared/protocol.ts + types.ts + src/plugin/request-validator.ts, 36 tests), restart-lock (src/plugin/restart-lock.ts, 10), checkpoint-gate (src/plugin/checkpoint-gate.ts, 11), restart-ticket (src/plugin/ticket-store.ts + atomic.ts, 19). 76 module tests. Registered the building in city/CITY_IMPLEMENTATION_MANIFEST.json with capabilityProvider:false and extended the census test; documented the mission-incubation identity, the capabilityProvider flag and the consumption reconciliation in both city architecture docs.

Three fidelity defects were found by review after the first ports reported green, all in the same class: the port had ADDED semantics the donor does not have. (1) restart-ticket's verifyTicket grew a field-presence and undeclared-field rung the donor lacks, changing verdicts for documents the donor accepts, and buildTicket grew a draft guard the donor does not have; (2) restart-ticket inlined its own copy of the checksum-defining canonicalJson and restart-lock/checkpoint-gate re-declared vocabularies that restart-protocol already owns, breaking the donor's single shared layer; (3) one checkpoint-gate assertion asserted a leniency the port had invented rather than the donor's declared required fields. A fourth, self-inflicted failure was a pinned 71-character digest literal silently written to disk with one extra character.

Full CI-equivalent suite green: pnpm test 59/59, apps/rooms tests 67/67, city/test-all.mjs 206/206, verify-promotion-history.mjs 10 records verified, check:docs SYNCHRONIZED in docs, evidence and data-records. New module tests: restart-protocol 36, restart-lock 10, checkpoint-gate 11, restart-ticket 19 (76 total). restart-protocol additionally carries a differential harness result of 32,801 comparisons against a fresh transcription of the donor validator with 0 mismatches.

Real consumption verified end to end: a real dev-gateway instance accepted a task over HTTP, restarted on the same store, and its post-restart decision about whether interrupted work may resume is now made by the migrated checkpoint-gate module with Utopia's policy supplied as data. tests/gateway.test.mjs proves the gateway and the Core agree: a task that never started requires no checkpoint and stays QUEUED, while a task that had reached RUNNING has no bound checkpoint port, so the donor's fail-closed default refuses it and it becomes FAILED with the unchanged error text and event. Protocol, state names and response shapes are unchanged.

Repairs, all verified against the donor line by line. verifyTicket is now exactly the donor's six rungs in the donor's order with the donor's detail strings and no seventh rung; buildTicket is the donor's body verbatim, so an invalid instant throws the donor's own RangeError. The added rungs and the guard are deleted, and the false justification for them is replaced by a verdictParity block stating that no verdict differs. canonicalJson is imported from restart-protocol instead of duplicated, and restart-lock/checkpoint-gate import their vocabularies from restart-protocol rather than re-declaring them, so the donor's plugin -> shared direction is preserved as a cross-module import; identity assertions prove a re-declared copy cannot return silently. The leniency assertion now asserts the donor-faithful strictness plus a positive companion. The corrupted digest literal was repaired and the suite asserts its 71-char/64-hex shape. No assertion was deleted or weakened to reach green.
